name: Twenty-four seven Holdings Inc.
summary: Twenty-four seven Holdings Inc. provides personal training in Japan through personal training and real estate-related segments. Its gyms include 24/7 Workout for personal training, 24/7 Fit for newcomers, 24/7Pilates for one-on-one lessons, and FITTERIA, a self-service gym for women. It also rents out real estate and was formerly called Twenty-four seven Inc.
